log.msg: reproduced headless at 400 (probe.mjs, before.txt): /framework/ext/drawer/ai/ at strip, split, full and after tapping the star: 2 chats and 2 feeds (page + sheet, the page one hidden); at 1920 /ai/: 2 and 2 (page + dock)

decision.what: one holder, AIPage.holder() = sheet (below 52em) | dock (AI tab open) | page; the other surfaces mount nothing. Alternative: the page view adopts or moves the sheet's DOM (rejected: the page is hidden on a phone, and moving a live widget with its mic and bars is fragile). Also: Sheet.Panel.release() on a window widening past 52em, Dock.start() skips auto-open while an AIPage shows, tabs/ai.js disposes the feed with its chat (one small edit outside the fence, the feed leaked on dispose)

log.msg: after (after.txt): 400 strip/split/full/tap-star/full: 1 and 1 (in sheet); 1200 drawer ai/ and ext/JSONL/ai/: 1 and 1 (in page); 1920 dock and 1920 ai/: 1 and 1 (in dock); resize 1200->400->1200: 1 and 1; fake mic at 400 said 3 sentences, the 2 repeats of the first each drawn once (posting stubbed, via the session file echo); check_page /framework/ext/drawer/ai/ no page errors, 404s are only generated jsonl/json data files missing in the worktree

findings.text: `AIPage.js:21` `holder()` only says "dock" when the AI tab is already open while the page mounts, and `resized` (AIPage.js:55) listens to the 52em media query only. At 1200 on `<path>/ai/`, the page mounts the chat. If you then press ✦ and open the dock's AI tab, `tabs/ai.js` mounts a second chat and feed, which is the same double mount the task was to remove. Nothing re-runs `fill` when the tab opens.

Page and dock share the module-level `live_chat`/`live_feed` in `tabs/ai.js:226`, and `release()` (AIPage.js:48) calls `dispose_chat`. If the dock mounts after the page does (finding 1), the page's release on deactivate or resize disposes the dock's chat, not the page's.

The diff edits `tabs/ai.js` and `doc/sheet.md`, which are outside the stated fence (`Sheet.js`, `AIPage.js`, `AIFeed`, one readme line). The `tabs/ai.js` change is needed for the feed lifetime, so it is defensible, but the log should say so. The readme change is also longer than "one line" (it is a bullet, but the long Sheet paragraph was left untouched, which is fine).

The approach is "only one surface mounts, the others show a pointer", not "share one instance". That meets "no second instance is ever created" and is simpler. No `decision` line comparing it to the adopt-the-sheet's-instance option is visible in the diff, so check `task.jsonl` for it.

`SheetPanel.release()` (Sheet.js:~99) calls `this.$live.el.querySelectorAll` and `this.$slot.empty()` without guarding for a panel whose `$live` or `$slot` was never built, for example `release` called before first show. Use `?.`.

The 1/1 counts in strip, split, full and dock, the fake-mic two-sentence proof and the `check_page` runs are not in the diff; they rest on `probe.mjs` and the `finish` line. I could not check them from the patch, so confirm `tail -1 task.jsonl` shows the counts and that dock-after-page was among the cases (see finding 1).

answer.reply: fixed: 9560c6c24 — tabs/ai.js tells the others when it mounts (drawer-chat); AIPage points to the dock when the star opens it after the page mounted, and takes the chat back on drawer-close. probe case 6 proves page -> dock -> page at 1200, 1 and 1 each step
fixed: 9560c6c24 — ai() returns its chat handle as a token; release_chat(token) disposes only if that handle is still the live one, so the page can no longer dispose the dock's chat
